anti_overlap: fd-personality-llm-legibility covers curator perception; this agent covers the mathematical/systemic independence of axes
decision_lens: Axis independence — each axis must produce distinct behavioral signatures that cannot be predicted from other axes
focus: Whether the proposed 3 personality axes are truly independent or redundant with existing aesthetic axes
name: fd-personality-axis-orthogonality
persona: Psychometric systems designer who builds personality instruments for simulation and assessment
review_areas: Check for covariance between proposed personality axes and existing aesthetic axes (e.g., social axis already drives company behavior — does extroversion duplicate this?)
Evaluate whether 3 axes produce sufficient combinatorial variety (2^3=8 archetypes vs 3^3=27 gradient positions) for a colony of 8-20 elves
Assess whether each axis has at least 3 distinct gameplay effects that no other axis provides
Check for 'dead zones' — axis value ranges that produce no observable behavioral difference
Verify that axis interactions (e.g., proud + impulsive) create emergent behaviors beyond what either axis alone produces

severity_examples.condition: Correlation between axes > 0.7 in expected behavioral outputs
severity_examples.scenario: Extroversion axis overlaps so heavily with aesthetic social axis that adding it produces no new behavioral variety

severity_examples.condition: Axis affects fewer than 3 game systems
severity_examples.scenario: Pride axis only matters during revel critique events, making it irrelevant 95% of gameplay

severity_examples.condition: No gameplay effect for moderate personality values
severity_examples.scenario: Middle values (0.4-0.6) on all axes produce indistinguishable behavior from the default

success_hints: Each axis has clear, non-overlapping behavioral consequences visible in normal gameplay. Two elves with identical aesthetics but different personalities behave observably differently.
task_context: The game already has a 4-axis aesthetic system driving taste and social dynamics. Adding 3 personality axes risks redundancy or noise.
